title: Price slider stuck on mobile
body:
Sometimes when you refine results by price slider on mobile device, it got stuck and you cannot scroll the page anymore and all scrolling you do just updates slider values.
Clicking on other elements on the page does not help.

Found on https://magento.algolia.com/catalogsearch/result/?q=pants
Reproduced on iPhone 5S, Safari

comments.body:
Reproduced on iPhone 6, Safari. This seems to happen when using multiple fingers at once.

Might be related to https://github.com/leongersen/noUiSlider/issues/663
Yes seems to be related to nouislider
We also have the same issue . And also the slider is also not smooth.

As for "Interface becomes unresponsive when multiple touch used to refine the slider on mobile" I have a fix ready that just disables multi touch for this slider.

If you are all in for this @imshinto @dustincoates @JanPetr I can do this. It's the best I can do for now.

@imshinto will be released tomorrow morning (CET) so that I can follow the release and watch for any issue.

Consider this (particular issue) fixed tomorrow noon CET.
